message.content: [罪名]侵犯注册商标专用权罪<eoa>
message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes based on facts: production and sale of counterfeit alcoholic beverages with counterfeit trademarks. Under Chinese criminal law, this is "侵犯注册商标专用权罪" (Trademark infringement) and possibly "生产、销售假冒注册商标的商品罪". The specific article is 213 of Criminal Law: "生产、销售假冒注册商标的商品罪". Also could be "非法经营罪"? But the fact is about counterfeit goods, so main crime is "侵犯注册商标专用权罪" (Trademark infringement) and "生产、销售假冒注册商标的商品罪". However Chinese law distinguishes: Article 213: "生产、销售假冒注册商标的商品罪" is a specific offense. Also Article 224: "侵犯知识产权罪" includes trademark infringement. The typical charge is "侵犯注册商标专用权罪". The prosecution likely charges "侵犯注册商标专用权罪". Could also be "非法生产、销售假冒注册商标的商品罪". Usually they use "侵犯注册商标专用权罪". So answer: [罪名]侵犯注册商标专用权罪<eoa>.

If multiple: maybe also "非法经营罪"? But not directly indicated. The fact only supports trademark infringement. So single.

Thus output.
